entries.title: FM Synthesis
entries.idiom: 1980s Memphis-design screenprint, two sine ribbons wound together flaring into a bell
entries.hero_prompt: Screenprint in the bold playful manner of 1980s Memphis design, flat pastel pink, mint and pale yellow with heavy black line, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible ink texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, wide panoramic composition: from the left edge two smooth wavy ribbons run side by side, one thick and slow with a few wide waves, one thin and quick with many tight waves; toward the middle the thin ribbon winds tightly around the thick one like a vine around a pole, and on the right the wound pair flares open into one large bronze hand-bell standing on its rim, short curved ring lines spreading from its mouth. Behind, a loose scatter of small black dots, triangles and squiggles on the pastel ground. Lots of open space.
entries.icon_prompt: Screenprint emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a pastel pink ground, no shading or gradients: a bold hand-bell whose handle is one thick wavy line rising from its top, with two short curved ring lines beside its mouth. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.

entries.title: Cycle 5 Explorer
entries.idiom: Sonia Delaunay-like gouache colour disc, a turnable ring with a seven-segment window
entries.hero_prompt: Gouache and cut-paper painting in the manner of Sonia Delaunay's colour discs, flat opaque colour, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible brush and cut paper-edge texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, wide panoramic composition: on a cream drafting sheet lies one large round disc pinned at its centre with a brass pin, made of three concentric rings, each ring cut into twelve equal segments like slices; over it sits a loose dark outer ring with one wide opening cut through it, and through the opening seven neighbouring segments show in bright colour, running from sunny yellow through orange and rose to deep indigo, while the other five lie under the dark ring, hatched with diagonal lines. A faint ruled straight line runs the full width behind the disc. Yellow, rose, indigo, black and cream.
entries.icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a warm amber ground, no shading or gradients: a thick ring made of seven solid blocks in one unbroken arc, separated by narrow gaps, with the rest of the ring cut away to leave a wide open gap, and a solid dot at the centre. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.

entries.title: Rational Hearing
entries.idiom: hand-coloured 15th-century music-theory woodcut, two strings in two and three loops, the sounding one red
entries.hero_prompt: Hand-coloured woodcut in the manner of a 15th-century Italian music-theory book, black ink on cream with a single accent of engineering red, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible woodcut line and watercolour texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, wide panoramic composition: across the foreground a long plain wooden box with two strings stretched side by side along its top, both inked red; the upper string shimmers in two smooth swelling loops, the lower in three. Behind it, from a wooden beam, hangs a row of plain unmarked bronze bells in falling sizes, and beside them stand two open organ pipes, one longer than the other. An old scholar in a long robe, seen from behind with his hands in his sleeves, tilts his head to listen. Cream, black, ochre and one red.
entries.icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a warm cream ground, no shading or gradients: two thick strings stretched side by side between two solid posts, the upper string swelling into two loops and the lower into three loops. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.

entries.title: Synth Templates
entries.idiom: 1920s French pochoir stencil print, one cut plate printed three ways and a sheet still empty
entries.hero_prompt: Hand-coloured pochoir stencil print in the manner of a 1920s French stencil portfolio, flat saturated colour laid through cut plates, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible stencil-brush stipple and paper texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, wide panoramic composition: on a plain wooden worktable at the left lies a thin brass stencil plate with one long shape cut through it, a row of square-cornered steps going up, across, down and across again, and a round stubby stencil brush rests beside it; to the right three sheets of cream paper lie in a row, each printed through the same plate with the same stepped shape, one in deep blue, one in vermilion, one in ochre, each with its own brush texture; a fourth sheet at the far right lies empty, waiting. Generous empty space.
entries.icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a vermilion ground, no shading or gradients: a thick rectangular plate with one bold stepped slot cut through it, square-cornered steps up, across and down, the ground showing through the slot. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.

entries.title: Resonance and Damping
entries.idiom: Futurist-like charcoal motion study, a swing's arcs narrowing as it comes to rest
entries.hero_prompt: Charcoal drawing in the manner of a Futurist motion study, soft black charcoal with one wash of warm ochre on pale grey-white paper, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible charcoal smudge and paper grain, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, wide panoramic composition: a plain wooden swing hangs on two ropes from a high crossbar, a small child sitting on it with legs out; behind the swing its earlier positions are drawn as faint repeated outlines of the seat and ropes, fanning in a wide arc at first, each one a little narrower, closing toward the seat hanging straight down; a man stands to one side with his arms lowered, having just stopped pushing, watching it come to rest. Evening light, long empty ground, plenty of pale paper.
entries.icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on an ochre ground, no shading or gradients: a swing seat hanging on two straight ropes from a crossbar, and below it three thick nested curved arcs, the outermost the widest. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.

entries.title: Auditory Illusions
entries.idiom: Bridget Riley-like op-art screenprint, an ear that exists only where the waves bend
entries.hero_prompt: Op-art screenprint in the manner of Bridget Riley, black and white with one band of warm red, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible ink texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, wide panoramic composition: the whole field filled with even parallel wavy black lines on white that ripple and seem to shimmer; near the centre the lines bend, crowd and thin out so that the shape of a large human ear appears, made only by where the waves bend, with no outline drawn around it; deep inside the ear the lines curl into a tight spiral. One horizontal band of warm red wavy lines runs through the field. Crisp, optical, flat, mostly white.
entries.icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a warm red ground, no shading or gradients: a bold human ear seen from the side, its inner curl cut as one thick spiral. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.

entries.title: The Gallery
entries.idiom: ink-and-watercolour root-atlas soil section, a life's works buried in the roots under the house
entries.hero_prompt: Ink and watercolour in the manner of a hand-drawn botanical root atlas, a soil cross-section, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible pen line and watercolour wash, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, wide panoramic composition: along the top a thin strip of ground with a long low house of many lit windows standing on it; below the ground line, filling most of the frame, a great root system drawn in brown ink spreads from left to right like a long path; caught among the roots, as if the roots had grown from them, lie small buried things in a loose row from left to right: a child's wooden recorder, a plain unmarked black record, a plain cassette, an acoustic guitar, a stack of loose paper tied with string, a small wooden box with two knobs. Warm earth browns, ochre and soft green.
entries.icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on an ochre ground, no shading or gradients: a thick plain square picture frame, empty, with one bold root growing down through its opening and out below the frame. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.

entries.title: Synthesis Notes (Loudon)
entries.idiom: Renaissance red-chalk drawing, a wave carved out of a marble block, the chisel laid down
entries.hero_prompt: Red chalk drawing on cream paper in the manner of a Renaissance sculptor's drawing, sanguine with a little white chalk, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible chalk stroke and paper grain, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, wide panoramic composition: a rough block of marble stands on a wooden workbench in a quiet stone studio, its left side still raw and jagged; from its right side a smooth polished wave form has been carved out, one long rolling curve rising and falling as it emerges from the stone, half freed; marble chips and dust lie on the bench and the floor, and a mallet and a flat chisel rest on the bench beside the block. Morning light from a high window. Sanguine, cream and soft white.
entries.icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a sanguine red-brown ground, no shading or gradients: a thick square block whose top edge has been carved into one smooth bold wave curve, with a chisel leaning against its side. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.

_notes: FM Synthesis — two sine ribbons, one slow and one quick, wound together and flaring into a bronze hand-bell: the page's exemplifies label, two sines make a bell; Memphis because FM was the sound of that decade. Icon a bell with a sine for a handle. -> FM Synthesis/FM Synthesis — hero.png, FM Synthesis/FM Synthesis — icon.png

Cycle 5 Explorer — a Delaunay colour disc of twelve segments with a dark ring whose window shows seven, yellow to indigo: the decoder ring and the seven-note window, bright to dark modes as colour, no note names. Icon the seven-of-twelve arc. Replaces the unrendered sidecar prompt, which asked for mode names, letters and numerals. -> Projects/Cycle 5 Explorer/Cycle 5 Explorer — hero.png, ... — icon.png

Rational Hearing — two red strings on one box, one in two loops and one in three, with bells and two pipes behind and a scholar listening: 3:2 shown in a body, and the handout's one red thing is what is sounding. Icon the two strings. Replaces the unrendered sidecar prompt, which asked for a ladder of numerals and a 3/2 fraction. -> Projects/Rational Hearing/Rational Hearing — hero.png, ... — icon.png

Synth Templates — one brass stencil cut as a square wave, printed through three times in three colours, a fourth sheet blank: the cut is the essential setting, the ink is taste, three prints are three synths, and the empty sheet is the learner's. Icon the stencil plate. -> Projects/Synth Templates/Synth Templates — hero.png, ... — icon.png

Resonance and Damping — a swing the man has stopped pushing, its ghost arcs narrowing to plumb: the page's opening image, where it rings and how fast it forgets. Icon a swing over three shrinking arcs. Settles both flags (the 2026-10-25 scoped-linters one and the 2026-11-07 faceless-entry one). Charcoal can go dark; brighten about 20% if it vanishes under the veil. -> Resonance and Damping/Resonance and Damping — hero.png, ... — icon.png

Auditory Illusions — an op-art field where an ear shows only where the waves bend: hearing building what isn't there, drawn as an illusion of the eye, which is the page's twin-in-the-eye method. Icon a bold ear with a spiral curl. -> Auditory Illusions/Auditory Illusions — hero.png, ... — icon.png

The Gallery — a soil section under a long low house, a root system running left to right through buried works (a recorder, a record, a cassette, a guitar, papers, a box with knobs): the forward vector's root system under the house, never a list of credits; no figure, so Loudon is not drawn. Icon an empty frame with a root through it. -> Projects/The Gallery/The Gallery — hero.png, ... — icon.png

Synthesis Notes (Loudon) — a marble block with a wave carved out of it, chisel and mallet laid down: the notes' own line, the oscillator is marble and the filter is the chisel. Icon a block with a wave-carved top and a chisel. -> Synthesis Notes (Loudon)/Synthesis Notes (Loudon) — hero.png, ... — icon.png
